book.name: Annabi Mika
book.title: Ala xa masenyi Annabi Mika bɛ Ala xa masenyi Annabi Mika bɛ

content.text: «I tan, Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Efarata, naxan xurun Yuda xabilɛe ya ma,
mixi nde minima nɛ i ya ma naxan Isirayila yamarima n bɛ.
A xa fe fɔlɔxi tɛmui dangixi nɛ naxan makuya pon.»
Na na a toma, Alatala Isirayila raboloma,
han furi ginɛ fa a xa di baride.
Na tɛmui, na di ngaxakerenyie dɔnxɔɛe fama nɛ gbilende Isirayila.
A kelima nɛ, a ti a xa xurusee ya ra,
a e dɛ madon a Marigi Alatala Xili Xungbe Kanyi sɛnbɛ ra.
E sabatima nɛ a fanyi ra,
barima a xa xunnakeli duniɲa birin lima nɛ.
A tan nan findima won ma bɔɲɛsa ra.
Asiriyakae na fa won ma bɔxi ma,
e so won ma yire makantaxie kui,
won kantama solofere nun mangɛ solomasaxan nan kelima e xili ma.
E Asiriya bɔxi yamarima nɛ santidɛgɛma ra,
e dɔxɔ Nimirodi xa bɔxi xun ma tanbɛ ra.
Won ma mangɛ won bama nɛ Asiriyakae yi ra,
e na tugan won ma naaninyi xun ma, e so won ma bɔxi kui.
Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe luma nɛ duniɲa sie ya ma,
alɔ xini naxan kelima Alatala ma,
alɔ tunɛ ye naxan dɔxɔma burɛxɛ ra.
E mu e xaxili tima ibunadama ra,
e mu e yɛtɛ taxuma mixi yo ra.
Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe luma nɛ duniɲa si gbegbe ya ma,
alɔ yɛtɛ naxan tima wulai subee tagi,
alɔ yɛtɛ yɔrɛ naxan ɲɛrɛma xurusee ya ma,
a fa dutun ndee ma, a e ibɔɔ, mixi yo mu nɔma e bade a yi ra.
I xun nakelima nɛ i yaxuie ya i, e birin sɔntɔ.
Alatala naxa a masen,
«Lɔxɔ nde fama a lide,
n wo xa soee nun wo xa sɔɔri ragisee xa fe kanama nɛ.
N wo xa bɔxi xa taae kanama nɛ,
n wo xa yire makantaxie rabira.
N wo xa duureya kanama nɛ,
n wo xa se matoe rayensen yɛ.
N wo xa kuyee nun wo xa gɛmɛ masolixi birin kanama nɛ.
Na tɛmui, wo mu suyidima se yailanxie bɛ sɔnɔn.
N wo xa Aseri wuri masolixie talama nɛ wo tagi,
n wo xa taae kanama nɛ,
n n gbeɲɔxɔma xɔnɛ nan kui, sie ma
naxee mu tin n xui suxude.»
